newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says accepts Bre-X proposal.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says accepts Bre-X proposal.

text.p: Indonesian Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said on Tuesday the government had accepted a proposal by Bre-X Minerals Ltd to develop the huge Busang gold find.

Bre-X said on Monday the company and its Indonesian partners had formed a joint venture with U.S. mining giant Freeport McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc to develop the Busang find in Indonesia's East Kalimantan province.
"The government has agreed to accept the Bre-X proposal," Sudjana told a Jakarta news conference.
Bre-X also announced on Monday the latest estimate of Busang gold reserves at 70.95 million ounces.
Sudjana said the Bre-X proposal submitted to the government for approval gave Bre-X 45 percent and Indonesian and government interests 55 percent.

He said the Indonesian interests had agreed to allocate a portion of their share to Freeport McMoRan, which amounted to 15 percent. Bre-X said Freeport would develop and operate the mine in remote rainforest on Borneo island.
